dogecoin.text:
Recently, Musk space company SpaceX said that it would accepting the meme-inspired cryptocurrency as payment for a mission.

 Dogecoin jumps 20% as Elon Musk says he's working to improve its efficiency.

@ElonMusk created a Twitter poll asking users if they wanted the electric vehicle maker to start accepting cryptocurrency Dogecoin, 78.2% users responding saying 'Yes'.
The poll had received a total of 39,22,516 votes.
